_comment: ticket #509 — single declaration of the tool belt every AI agent container ships. Extends the #366/#450 gh/yq/ripgrep hook rather than starting a second one. Consumed by _shared/engine.nix, which splices apt_packages + the gh/yq install into: (a) Type-B (wrap upstream image) builds when build.json sets docker.agent_toolbelt=true — see hermes-agent; (b) Type-A (own Dockerfile) builds via the @AGENT_TOOLBELT_APT@ / @AGENT_TOOLBELT_EXTRA_RUN@ placeholders — see my-ai_claude-api and my-ai-api. Add a tool ONCE here, never edit a Dockerfile's apt-get line directly. `containers` enumerates every AI container that must carry this declaration, so 9_others/test-agent-toolbelt.ts can fail when a fourth one is added without opting in.
_sudo_excluded_comment: sudo is deliberately NOT in this list. my-ai_claude-api and my-ai-api run as uid 10001, hermes-agent as uid 10001/10000 (see user-ai_hermes-agent/src/compose.nix HERMES_UID/HERMES_GID) — all three are unprivileged by design, and sudo would have no privilege to escalate to. Adding it just to complete a tool-name list would be theatre, not tooling.
